Italian EU long-term residence permit, needs NO sponsorship anywhere in the EU. ~3 years professional, all European startups, most recently Lead Developer at FlowSpace, Mar 2024 to Jul 2026, available now. DISCOVERY — at least 12 distinct searches, parallel where possible.
WebSearch with allowed_domains on: ["jobs.ashbyhq.com"], ["job-boards.greenhouse.io"], ["job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io"], ["join.com"], ["jobs.personio.com"], ["jobs.smartrecruiters.com"]
